===Basic Abilities===

* Head Shot - Bleeding Energon from a Head Shot causes direct damage over time. Additional Damage if the opponent is Sidestepping or Dodging.

** 25.9-49.7% chance to land a '''Headshot''' on Ranged Attacks, instantly inflicting 60% Attack and dealing 60% Attack as Bleed Damage over 3 seconds.

==Strategy==
===Player===
Arcee is an agile and critical-hitting, but frail Bot. Be careful not to take too many hits.

Her Headshots are quite powerful, but are hard to hit as they need you to keep at Ranged distance AND rely on Crits to proc. This is especially true if the opponent is Dashing In - increased Crit Rate means more Headshots. To get the most out of her deadly Ranged Attacks, chain a Special I and a ranged combo and hope a Headshot comes out of that.

Also, her Crits will grant her more Power - more Power for the many Special chains she can do.

===Opponent===
Arcee is relatively easy to fight, as she relies on Ranged Attacks to deal the most damage (those headshots!) Bots with high damage e.g. Demolitions Bots will immediately incinerate this fembot. One rule of thumb when facing her: '''don't stay at ranged distance as to not get shot in the head and in turn Bleed.''' (Except Brawlers who take advantage of Damaging Debuffs.) Power Lock stops her from gaining more Power on Crits.

Also [[Hot Rod]] Deceleration or Precision Buffs from the likes of eg. [[Drift]] will stop her annoying evades.

If you're raided by a player with an Arcee, your mod options are [[E.M.I. Module]]s.

===Strong Match-ups===
* [[Barricade]] - The bad cop won't be able to inflict his backfires if you can keep dodging.
* Anyone with high health.
* Arcee is an anti-Evade as Headshotted opponents will Bleed while evading, coupled with her Signature Ability.
*[[Megatron (ROTF)]] - Headshots and bleeds will ignore Megatron’s tough armor, of course she can evade his Heavy Attacks.

===Recommended Modules===
* The [[Laser Guidance Module]] boosts her sharpshooting shots and Special 1.
* The [[Nightbird's Mark]] will greatly enhance her Critical Hits and Evade. More Crits = More Headshots.
* The [[Scout's Sentry]] will also turn Arcee into Headshot Central.
* [[Prime Module]]s will enhance Arcee's base stats.

===Weak Match-ups===
* [[Motormaster]] - Arcee’s shots will do nothing to stop Motomaster from dashing at her
* [[Bonecrusher]] - Critical melees will be detrimental to her health.
* [[Grimlock]] - Grimlock will purify the bleeds and headshots Arcee inflicts, fueling Dino Rage.
* [[Optimus Primal]] - Arcee will be unable to land Critical hits and Bleeds, and gain Power. Any lucky headshots will also fuel the primate's Special I.
* If [[Optimus Prime (MV1)]] uses Melee Attacks while Headshotted, he will Heal.
* '''[[Thundercracker]]''' will turn Arcee's Headshots against her.
* '''[[Scorponok]]''' and his Dazed will not cower at Arcee's potentially debiliating Ranged Attacks.
* '''[[Tantrum]]''' - Dashing in may make Tantrum vunerable to Bleeds, but not when Frenzied.
* '''[[Megatronus]]''' - The relic of obedience will stop arcee from gaining her precision ambos and the relics of preservation and immortality will decrease the damage of head shots and bleeds.
